source.title: Applications for the WCA World Championship 2021
source.content:
The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for WCA World Championship 2021.

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

If you are interested, send your application documents privately to [board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org) **between 00:00 UTC of January 1st, 2020 and 23:59 UTC of June 30th, 2020. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions:** one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.
<!-- break -->
Within your application documents, please include at least the following information:

When would you like to hold the World Championship 2021?
1a. Possible dates
1b. Number of days of the competition.
1c. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.

Where would you like to hold the World Championship 2021 in your country?
2a. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing.
2b. Ease of international, national, and local travel.
2c. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories.
2d. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms).
2e. Technology available like internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment.
2f. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.

What would the organization team and staff look like?
3a. Core team members.
3b. Experience of the core team.
3c. Involvement of other parties.
3d. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff).
3e. Required support by foreign Delegates.

What would be the overall budget for the competition?
4a. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes).
4b. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

[Here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8) is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition. As an example of a successful application, [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/19rmV9liM1RAIYyK4DSkf6eHJSQem4aAr/view) is the winning bid for World Championship 2019 held in Melbourne, Australia.

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants and vote in order to decide where the 2021 World Championship will take place. If any Director will be involved in a team that sends in an application, he will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for a competition that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation and we look forward to viewing your applications!

translation.title: 2021 年 WCA 世界锦标赛承办申请
translation.content:
WCA 董事会现征集 2021 年 WCA 世界锦标赛的承办申请。

请与所在国家的代表讨论是否有意愿和能力承办。举办这一规模的比赛，需要在赛前和比赛期间投入大量时间与精力。

如有意承办，请在 **2020 年 1 月 1 日 00:00 UTC 至 2020 年 6 月 30 日 23:59 UTC 期间**，将申请材料私下发送至 [board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)。**材料须以 PDF 格式提交两个版本**：一份包含所有申请细节的完整版；另一份为公开版，如有敏感信息，应将其删除。

申请材料至少须包含以下信息：

计划何时举办 2021 年世锦赛？

- 1a. 可选日期
- 1b. 比赛天数
- 1c. 与各国学校假期的重合情况

计划在本国何处举办 2021 年世锦赛？

- 2a. 城市应对外国游客有吸引力，有观光机会
- 2b. 国际、国内及市内交通的便利程度
- 2c. 不同价位酒店、公寓的供应情况
- 2d. 场馆、面积及布置，包括舞台、观众区、练习桌和附属房间
- 2e. 网络、视频直播、灯光及音响等技术条件
- 2f. 可容纳的选手和观众人数

主办团队和工作人员如何组成？

- 3a. 核心团队成员
- 3b. 核心团队的经验
- 3c. 其他参与方
- 3d. 当地志愿者的数量和能力，建议约 20% 的选手参与工作人员工作
- 3e. 需要外国代表提供哪些支持

比赛的总体预算是多少？

- 4a. 支出：场馆、场馆服务、舞台、器材、装饰、网站、证件及挂绳和礼品包、奖品
- 4b. 收入：报名费、赞助、地方政府支持

[此处](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8)有一份示例文档，列出大型比赛需要安排并纳入预算的部分事项，清单并非详尽无遗。作为成功申办的例子，[此处](https://drive.google.com/file/d/19rmV9liM1RAIYyK4DSkf6eHJSQem4aAr/view)还提供了澳大利亚墨尔本 2019 年世锦赛的获选申办材料。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将与申请方面谈，并投票决定 2021 年世锦赛的举办地。如有董事参与某个申办团队，将由其他人员（例如高级代表或委员会、团队负责人）代替其参与遴选。

我们希望这场比赛能够进一步实践 WCA 大型赛事的理念，让协会的工作更加专业，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也向世界呈现尽可能精彩的比赛。

提前感谢大家的配合，期待收到各位的申请！
